brief.aiScope: AI explains and summarises backend-computed evidence. It does not compute positions, orbits, TCA, miss distance, Pc or risk, does not validate the physics, and cannot command a spacecraft.
brief.checkNote: Consistency check: a deterministic fact check of numbers, risk tier, recommendation and intent language, plus a second pass by the same local model — not independent validation. Unconfirmed LLM comments are shown as advisory notes.
brief.notYet: Brief not yet available — reopen the event to retry.
brief.generating: Generating brief… this view refreshes automatically.
brief.dvNote: Simplified estimate — not a maneuver plan or recommendation.
brief.mtLabel: LOCAL MACHINE TRANSLATION — English is the source of record
brief.mtTip: Translated on this machine by a local model (no external service). Numbers, IDs and acronyms are protected and kept exactly as computed.
brief.translationUnavailable: Dynamic translation unavailable — showing English brief.
hist.title: AUDIT HISTORY
hist.empty: No decisions recorded for this event yet.
approval.reasonRecorded: Reason recorded — used as in-context prompt feedback for future briefs.
approval.whyDismiss: Why are you dismissing this assessment? Your reason is logged and included as in-context feedback in future brief prompts (no model training).
approval.placeholder: e.g. TLE too old to trust this geometry; prefer waiting for an updated element set...

analytics.title: Operator Decision Audit — AI Brief Outcomes
analytics.empty: No operator decisions recorded yet. Approve or dismiss an event and it will appear here. Decisions are audit records only — no spacecraft commands.
analytics.recent: Recent rejections — used as in-context prompt feedback (no model training)
analytics.noRejections: No rejections yet. When an operator dismisses an assessment with a reason, it is logged here and included as in-context feedback in future brief prompts (no model training).

acro.TCA: the predicted moment when the two objects are nearest
acro.Pc: estimated chance that the two objects collide
acro.TLE: public orbital elements used to predict a satellite's position
acro.SGP4: standard model that propagates TLE orbits forward in time
acro.NORAD: unique catalog number identifying a space object
acro.RPO: one spacecraft deliberately operating close to another
acro.CDM: standard message format for sharing conjunction warnings
acro.dv: velocity change a manoeuvre would need
acro.LLM: AI text model running locally that drafts the brief
acro.UTC: world reference time used for all timestamps
acro.SSA: knowing where space objects are and what they are doing
scale.label: Text size
limit.1: Orbits propagated with SGP4 from public TLE/GP element sets — position errors of the order of kilometres are normal and grow with element-set age.
limit.2: Uncertainty is a simplified isotropic Gaussian, not a covariance from orbit determination.
limit.3: Pc is a simplified analytic encounter-plane indicator (short-encounter assumption, assumed isotropic σ) — not an operational covariance-based Pc.
limit.4: The 10 km distance is a prototype candidate-screening threshold, not a collision criterion.
limit.5: The Δv figure is an illustrative estimate only — not a maneuver plan or recommendation.
limit.6: AI-drafted text may contain errors — the authoritative numbers are the computed values shown above.
limit.7: Decision-support only: no spacecraft is commanded by this system.

evo.single: Only one screening observation is available.
evo.notRecorded: Screening history has not been recorded for this event yet.
evo.ambiguous: Ambiguous match — more than one candidate within the correlation window

drivers.title: Risk drivers (computed values)
drivers.pcInputs: From miss distance, relative velocity and geometry at TCA, position σ and hard-body radius
drivers.noPc: Pc not computed — proximity watch, tier from dwell time and minimum distance
drivers.critNote: Asset criticality affects priority ordering only. It does not change Pc or the risk tier.
drivers.critNoteProx: Asset criticality affects priority ordering only. Proximity-watch priority does not use it, and it does not change the risk tier.
drivers.prioPc: Pc × criticality multiplier — feed ordering only
drivers.prioProx: Proximity priority = fixed proximity band + dwell-time bonus (only for extreme dwell) — feed ordering only
chain.title: EVIDENCE TRACE
chain.tip: Click a step to jump to its section. Physics steps are computed, the AI only explains, the operator decides, and decisions are audited.
chain.aiTip: AI explains backend-computed evidence only: it does not compute Pc, TCA or positions, does not validate the physics and sends no command. The deterministic fact check is authoritative; the LLM second pass is advisory (same model, not independent).
chain.humanTip: Operator decision — separate from the AI. Recorded in the audit trail; no command is sent to any spacecraft.
ai.statement: Physics evidence is generated by the deterministic backend. AI explains that evidence.
ai.status.pending: AI brief in progress — the computed evidence shown is final
ai.status.unavailable: AI UNAVAILABLE — deterministic assessment remains available
ai.status.checkFailed: AI CHECK FAILED — backend evidence remains authoritative
ai.status.checkNotRun: AI CHECK NOT COMPLETED — backend evidence remains authoritative
ai.status.available: AI AVAILABLE — brief drafted by the local LLM
ai.did.pending: Nothing yet — the brief is still being generated
ai.did.none: Nothing for this event — the brief is a deterministic template (local LLM unavailable)
ai.did.summarise: Summarised the backend-computed evidence (TCA, miss distance, Pc, risk tier)
ai.did.explain: Described the computed risk tier and its drivers in plain language
ai.did.readable: Wrote a human-readable assessment for the operator
ai.did.check: Ran an advisory same-model consistency check (the deterministic fact check is authoritative)
ai.did.translate: Provided a local machine translation of the brief (English remains the source of record)
ai.didNot.risk: Determine physical collision risk or the risk tier
ai.didNot.decision: Make the final decision — the operator does
